serde_json 1.0.154
Upstream: https://github.com/serde-rs/json
Revision: 20572a6d066958542d79cdd6cf1a7cd9f0c8e1f8
Crate SHA-256: e7e9cc8b1b85264074fbcc02a88680c4096b1e47df8f739dceb03bf482f04bd6
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0. See LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE.

Kiwix changes: use checked string scans, byte writes and text slicing in the
reader, writer and Value formatter. Use typed owned storage for boxed RawValue
and BorrowedRawValue for deserializing a borrowed raw span. The unchecked
RawValue constructor has been removed. The crate forbids unsafe Rust with all
features, including raw_value.

Deserialize borrowed raw fields into BorrowedRawValue<'a> by value and call
into_owned() to copy a retained span into a Box<RawValue>. An existing &RawValue
can still serve as a Deserializer.
